login_user.description: The login name used for remote connections.

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for connector commands.

window_size.description: Initial window size for the deployment pipeline.

dynamic_limit.description: Max arity for dynamic work-stealing mode. 0 = no max arity.

self_propagate.description: If true, enables -s to propagate taktuk binary to remote hosts.

connector_command.description: The command used to contact remote machines.

perl_interpreter.description: The command to use as Perl interpreter for auto-propagation.

remote_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories to set as PATH on remote hosts.

machines_file.description: Path to the file containing remote machine names.

commands.description: List of TakTuk commands to execute after deployment.
